_comment: The commissioner's rulings on transactions in Yahoo's log. 'void' on an 'add': it does not count against the weekly add budget and is not listed as an add; rosters are untouched (ROSTERS.json follows Yahoo). A ruling that matches no transaction raises. Read by scripts/sync_transactions.py and every reader of waivers_week{N}.txt (modules/transaction_rulings.py).

rulings.reason: Benton had already claimed Paul George in the group chat during week 1; the claim had not been applied yet. Garrett's add (dropped the same day) is void and his week-2 move count was set from 3 to 2.
